A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable, complete 32-page versions of the same paper. The main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–L support direct comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original suppression-validation results, a 20-participant human–CNN comparison, and cross-domain experiments in Sections 4–5, with additional empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including Tables 2–8 and the human, computer-vision, medical-imaging, and remote-sensing evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Table 1 retain the same suppression framework and six transformations. Refreshed illustrative outputs do not document a change to the method or model procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the curated ImageNet16 task, five computer-vision benchmarks, five MedMNIST-v2 datasets, and five remote-sensing datasets. The evaluated suppression scenarios and appendix source images are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same filtering comparators, and Table 3 retains the same human, CNN, and transformer comparisons. Comparator membership in the decision-rule and block-artifact experiments also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The image selection, participant protocol, suppression parameters, decision rules, accuracy normalization, and training settings in Sections 4–5 and the appendices are unchanged. The revised example images do not establish an experimental-setting change.

E4.justification: The parameter ablation, decision-rule comparison, class-wise analysis, alternative and joint suppression analyses, and block-edge control in Appendices D, G, I, and J are retained unchanged. Refreshed illustrations introduce no new analytical question.

E5.justification: Appendix F retains the paired t-tests with n=4 per group, effect sizes, 95% confidence intervals, and noise-ceiling estimates. Figure 5 retains its 1-sigma error bars; no seed or repeated-run reporting changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results and reported findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains ResNet50-standard relative accuracies of 0.276 under local-shape suppression and 0.795 under texture suppression. Figure 3 preserves all plotted values despite reversing the horizontal display direction.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–11 in Appendices A–B are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions, and conclusion retain the claims challenging inherent CNN texture bias, emphasizing local-shape reliance and its modulation by training or architecture, and identifying domain-specific reliance patterns.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning training, supervision, and domain characteristics are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning imperfect feature isolation, transformation artifacts, augmentation confounds, and human-study generalizability.

D1.justification: The appendices retain identical participant instructions, hyperparameters, preprocessing, checkpoint selection, hardware specifications, and training times. The code-availability statement and link are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning against Geirhos et al.'s cue-conflict evaluation, and all 66 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin stamp changes from v3 dated 28 October 2025 to v4 dated 6 January 2026. The title, authors, prose, captions, headings, and section organization otherwise remain identical.

P2.justification: Figure 3 now uses left-to-right increasing accuracy axes, larger labels, and repositioned legends. Figures 6–7 and 16–19 replace panels (b), (c), and (i) with different realizations of the stated patch and channel transformations, retaining the source images, captions, and arrangements. These are localized presentation revisions.

improvement.justification: Figure 3's larger labels and conventional increasing accuracy axes modestly improve readability of the central comparison. The refreshed appendix illustrations preserve the same demonstrations. Methods, empirical evidence, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to presentation.
